groups.title: The original and its sequel
groups.note: Part II begins straight after the first film.

groups.title: The standalone sequels
groups.note: Separate stories under the same name.

note: Only the first two films tell one continuous story. From part III onwards each film is its own story, even when it brings back a character, as Isaac's Return does. The 2009 film is a TV remake and the 2023 film is a reboot.
